title: Direct Entry: Wynwood Walls Guided Tour & Spray Can Art Class
includes: Access to 3 Indoor Fine Art Galleries & Quarterly Solo Exhibitions
All Art Class Materials (Souvenir Spray Can, Posca Markers, MTN Street Dabber Paint)
Official Wynwood Walls Authenticated Tour Guide
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Skip the ticket lines and dive straight into Miami’s ultimate street art experience. Perfect for domestic travelers and South Florida locals seeking a creative escape, this flexible ticket pairs an expert-guided tour with a hands-on, eco-friendly art workshop.

Express Entry: Bypass kiosk lines. Go straight to the Welcome Center desk.

Evolving Scale: Tour 38+ massive murals, a subway train installation, and 12 sculptures with an Authenticated Guide. The walls change constantly!

Fine Art Access: Entry to the Goldman Global Arts Gallery and quarterly solo artist exhibitions.

Eco-Friendly Class: Repurpose a recycled spray can into a personalized souvenir using professional Posca markers and MTN Street Dabbers.

Bonus Spray Wall: Try a complimentary 3-minute freestyle spray session on real walls (Ages 6+).

Flexibility: Explore at your own pace from 40 minutes up to 3 hours. Rain or shine (covered workshop). Includes free Wi-Fi.
